title: Summer afternoon at 350 drones: every case
description: A sunny 44 °C May afternoon on campus with a 3 m/s westerly. 350 drones fly repeated sorties for 10 minutes (battery swaps at the Mess A, Mess B and Sampoorna depots), and every case the demo handles happens at least once. A drone parked on a sun-baked pad during a ground stop heats up and is refused at pre-flight. Every BMS code shows up at each level it has (WARNING, CRITICAL, FAULT): low charge, cell failure, unknown capacity loss, cell sag, pack overheating, motor overheating, over-current, take-off mass and low-energy pre-flight refusals and a GNSS sensor fault. Alongside: a non-cooperative intruder, two blood runs, a medevac upgrade, GPS spoofing and quarantine, every operator console command, a VIP restricted area lifted early, a DTC outage with a queued command, and a storm cell with a second ground stop and a low-charge recall.
kpi_focus: BMS alerts by code and level
diversions, forced landings, no energy depletion

timeline: 350 drones on repeated sorties at 44 °C, 3 m/s westerly; depots swap batteries
@intruder (no Remote ID) Sampoorna → New Hostels: seen only by onboard sensing
@blood1 EMERGENCY SNCC → Hospital, priority 0, reserved emergency layer
Ground stop on the west campus (S3); @sunbaked sits powered on the sun-baked Guest House pad
@blood2 EMERGENCY Academic Area → Hospital: same pad, pad arbitration
@sunbaked pack heats on the pad: OVER_TEMP WARNING (55 °C), CRITICAL at 106 s (65 °C)
@spoof1, @spoof2 broadcast positions 30 m off: trusted-range + W-MSR correct them
Console on @courier: change layer (refused by the layer safety check), hold, resume, reroute to Mess B
Ground stop released: @sunbaked refused at pre-flight (BMS OVER_TEMP); powered down at 135 s
Operator quarantines both spoofers; @capacity loses 30 % capacity unseen, BMS learns it from voltage
Operator: @courier2 return to base
Operator: @lowbatt2 battery swap at Mess A, then on to its mission
Operator: ground eVTOL @courier3 now
VIP restricted area announced (active 180 s)
@cellfail cell failure → CELL_IMBALANCE CRITICAL, right of way, pad reserved, diverts
@sag cell failure at 45 % → cell sags below 3.0 V → UNDER_VOLTAGE FAULT, lands in place
@motor (4 kg payload, worn motor) flickers OVER_CURRENT WARNING ↔ all clear
@overheat pack overheating in flight: WARNING, CRITICAL (speed limit, 30 s hold), FAULT at 269 s
@overload 12 kg payload refused at pre-flight (over maximum take-off mass); @drained (16 %) refused for too little energy
Operator grounds every BMS CRITICAL drone
VIP area lifted early (tfr_cancel)
@cellfail refused for its next sortie: BMS CRITICAL (CELL_IMBALANCE)
@gnss GNSS degradation → SENSOR_FAULT, lands in place
DTC link down (to 345 s): routine traffic loiters, emergencies continue; command at 330 s queued
@motor reaches 110 °C: OVER_TEMP + OVER_CURRENT CRITICAL, diverts after 30 s
@lowbatt (32 %) reaches UNDER_VOLTAGE CRITICAL, lands at the nearest pad, queues for a battery swap
eVTOL @medevac upgraded to priority 0 → Hospital
Storm cell crosses the campus centre north → south; ground stop at Mess B 440–500 s
Recall every drone below 25 % SoC
